snippet.title: Tairum - Cyberpunk Roguelite - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to New Elysium of 2098, where even afterlives have been commercialised. Become a Phantom, an undying rebel fighting the Tairum Corporation, a company built on greed which controls Death itself. A mysterious Caretaker won't let you stay dead. Tairum must fall.

Tairum is a top-down cyberpunk auto-shooter roguelite where every fight lasts under two minutes and every route can either award you or bring more obstacles along your way.

Wishlist now Tairum on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5043840/Tairum/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=always_on 
Come join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/VDeHk36p9X
